name: The Office
source:
Gail & Cindy are both secretaries in the firm, XYZ_Corporation. They both wish to grow at their work place and aim to be the Personal Assistant/Project Manager of their CFO(i.e Dave). Gail is a self-made independent woman who has gone through a lot of hardships to reach this position in her life. However, she strives for more and despite her morality, she is compelled to go to any extent to fulfill her thirst for success at her career.

Her boyfriend Nathan, who is a mediocre photographer at AB_studios is very supportive of her and takes care of her immensely. Gail reciprocates his feelings but at the end there are significant choices that she would have to make, if she decides to reach her goal.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/damaged_coda]Patreon[/url]]
